plan.goal: Seed HUVEC endothelial cells at 5e4 cells/cm^2 onto the 0.08 cm^2 culture area of a 400 um x 20 mm channel.
plan.rationale: HUVEC seeding at 5e4 cells/cm^2 onto a 0.08 cm^2 channel culture area. This density is at the upper end of the HUVEC seeding range (1e4-2e4 cells/cm^2 per registry), chosen for rapid monolayer formation before perfusion. Channel geometry: 400 um wide, 20 mm long (height not specified for seeding).
caveats: 5e4 cells/cm^2 is at the upper end of the HUVEC seeding range (1e4-2e4 cells/cm^2); confirm the line tolerates this density without over-confluence
Channel height assumed 100 um for geometry; verify actual device height
Confirm the 0.08 cm^2 culture area matches the actual channel footprint before seeding
